description: List the logos stored for the workspace, to get the `id` that other tools need. `type` selects which set is returned: `logo` (default) for dealer logos drawn on finished photos, passed as `logo.id` to generate_background, or `plate` for designs shown on the license plate, passed as `license_plate_logo.id`. Each entry has `id`, `type`, `image_url` and `created_at`. Also call it before delete_logo, or before upload_logo to see whether the logo is already stored. Read-only and free. For background scenes use list_backgrounds instead.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

name: list_logos
title: List logos
